Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human target CHEMBL2292. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require compound_structures to be present (INNER JOIN) and require docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi to be non-null. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Filter by target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2292' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
